titles.head: Sydney Opera House
titles.text: Every shell is cut from one sphere, 75.2 m in radius: the rule Utzon settled on in 1961.

titles.head: Under the Bridge
titles.text: The Cross Harbour ferries run on the timetable's legs, wharf to wharf, with their wakes on the moving sea.

titles.head: Sydney Harbour Bridge
titles.text: An arch of 503 m, its crown 134 m above the sea, set out from the two pylons' footprints.

titles.head: Walk it
titles.text: Talk to the people who know the city, ride the ferries, fly under the Bridge.
